newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SAVINGS BANK SEES 11.4 MLN LITAS '97 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: SAVINGS BANK SEES 11.4 MLN LITAS '97 PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's state-owned Savings Bank said on Thursday that the bank was targetying an 11.4 million litas profit for 1997.
"The experts of the bank forecast that the profit is growing according to plan and at the end of the year will reach 11.4 million litas," the bank said in a statement.
The state-run Savings Bank reported on Wednesday that its net profit for the first five months of the year was 2.1 million litas compared to 6.4 million litas in the same period in 1996.
The bank also said that its profit during the first five months of the year was 4.7 million litas and 2.6 million litas of it was transferred to special provisions.
The bank had a net profit of 30 million litas in 1996 after posting a huge loss of 39 million litas in 1995.
